requirement: Update a clinical metric: the metric must exist and be live, then map the new name, description, version, publisher, and applied flag onto the tracked entity (the code is immutable), save it, and report Updated.

preconditions.text: A live clinical metric exists for the target id
The target id matches no live metric
The mapper reports a failure for the command

inputs.text: Update the name, description, version, and publisher of a live metric
Update whose mapper reports a mapping failure
Update request with an unknown id
Update request for a metric that was soft deleted beforehand

returns.text: Success with Updated status; the mapped fields and UpdatedAt are persisted
The code stays unchanged because it is immutable after creation
The applied flag follows the command
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Clinical metric not found' error
Failure from the mapper is forwarded and nothing is persisted

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
